correctness.rationale: The mathematical chain is sound. Han–Liu's Corollary 4.8 gives the dual von Neumann–Jordan constant at most \(1+8\sqrt\delta\) under the almost-BCD hypotheses. Passer's quantitative Jordan–von Neumann theorem converts \(C_{NJ}=1+\varepsilon\) into \(1+O_m(\varepsilon)\) Banach–Mazur distance, yielding the displayed square-root rate. Han–Liu's perturbation theorem gives BCD error of quadratic order in the perturbation, and the standard lower comparison from parallelogram defect to Banach–Mazur distance yields square-root sharpness.
